title: Senators back restoration of funding for DepEd’s Aral Program

blocks.text: Screengrab Senate of the Philippines / YouTube MANILA, Philippines — Senators are eyeing the restoration of funding for the Department of Education’s (DepEd) Academic Recovery and Accessible Learning (Aral) program. During the Senate Committee on Finance’s hearing on DepEd’s 2027 spending plan on Friday, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian and Sens. Bam Aquino, Joel Villanueva, and Erwin Tulfo separately raised concerns over the zero allocation for Aral. Tulfo was the first to question the lack of a dedicated budget for the program, pointing out that DepEd had sought P15.32 billion for Aral but received no allocation under the National Expenditure Program (Nep).
